faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long do I have to pay?
faq.a1: You have 24 hours from booking. If you don't pay, the booking expires and the spot is released.
faq.a2: Yes, as long as there are more than 24 hours before the workshop starts. Refund conditions will be published before launch.
faq.a3: After payment, Tallerya confirms your participation. We will notify you by email and in your account.
faq.a4: Only some of them, and it is always stated on the course page. We will ask for your consent before publishing any content.
faq.q5: Do you store my card details?
faq.a5: No. Payment happens on the provider's gateway; Tallerya never sees or stores card data.

legal.draftNotice: Draft: this text must be reviewed by legal counsel before going live.
legal.privacyBody: We only collect the data needed to manage your bookings: name, email, phone and language. Marketing communications are optional and you can withdraw consent at any time. We do not store card data. You can request deletion of your data from your profile.
legal.termsBody: Each booking is for one person. Bookings close 24 hours before the start and can be cancelled until then. Payment must be completed within 24 hours. Participation is confirmed once Tallerya accepts it.
